sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Ninth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XL OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XL OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance,
2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 15th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(18)/70-IX, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the-North-West Frontier
Province Local Government (Nineth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 156 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001

ORDINANCE XL OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XL OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance,
2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 15th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(18)/70-IX, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 156 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001).--In the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001), in
section 156,--
(i) in
sub-section (4), for the words "sixty days", the words and comma
"as far as practicable, one hundred and twenty days" shall be
substituted; and
(ii) in
sub-section (5) for the words "thirty days", the words and comma
"as far as practicable, one hundred and twenty days" shall be
substituted.
